change: Regenerated all six previously screened motor-power paths at 0.075 and 0.05 mm on the current working-tree PCB after the stale-hash review finding. Geometry differed from the previous board; results were recalculated rather than relabeled. No PCB/circuit changes were made by this refresh.

before.method: 9-point DC sheet-conductance screening; 35 um copper at 20 C, 20 um via plating, 1.6 mm equally spaced stack
limitations: Grid approximation; validate mesh convergence and native connectivity separately
Ideal terminal contacts; via contacts approximate, copper thickness and barrel plating are assumptions
Excludes connector/contact, shunt and transistor resistance, AC/PWM/proximity effects and temperature feedback
DC 5.5 A comparison is not a duty-cycle, temperature-rise or current-rating qualification

reproduction.all_paths: For each unique net/from/to in after, motor_output_paths and b1_drain_to_shunt, export the current board and run the recorded solver at both 0.075 and 0.05 mm. Native DRC currently reports text-only findings; zero unconnected/parity/copper violations, not a clean fabrication gate.

qualification: No temperature-rise, PWM-current or 5.5 A continuous-current qualification is claimed.

previous_review.change: Added RGB, board-power LED, reset-safe buzzer, isolated EEPROM programming access and eight probe pads; rerouted affected local copper and relocated four vias away from solder lands. Removed paste apertures from all 19 bare service probe pads while retaining copper and mask openings. Preserved all nine Kelvin/analog branches and the existing motor-power corridors. Rechecked A1/B1 drain-to-shunt and all four motor-output paths at 0.075/0.05 mm.
